## Current objective:
Fix webhook signature verification failures in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` causing customer 400s. Invoice pagination work is paused. Redis cutover steps 7–9 remain pending.

## Ruled-out approaches:
- `declarative_base()`; replaced with `DeclarativeBase`.
- `Invoice.query.get()`; replaced with `session.get()`.
- Billing service-owned sessions; use injected session.
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours; caused stuck jobs to remain invisible for hours.

## Recent work:
Added safe configuration-loading debug logging and request-ID health-log coverage. Fixed scheduler DST handling using timezone-aware `datetime.combine`; scheduler tests now pass, including midnight DST regression. Redis reconciliation found zero differences in 100,000 sampled keys; source writes are paused. Added stronger UTC and Eastern wall-time assertions. Full suite previously had 142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 health-log failure, then health tests passed.
